# Vendored W3C stylesheet

`w3c-base.css` is a local copy of the W3C specification base stylesheet from
<https://www.w3.org/StyleSheets/TR/2021/base.css>, retrieved on 2026-08-05.
It is embedded into the generated Construct-DCAT snapshots so the published
documentation does not depend on a remote stylesheet at runtime.

The upstream stylesheet is provided by W3C under the
[W3C Software and Document License](https://www.w3.org/copyright/software-license-2023/).
